notes.title: "Launch Problem" solved
notes.notes: Dear players, we apologize for the inconvenience caused. The game is now working properly. Unfortunately the new system did not support our source file so we had to fix it and it took time.

notes.title: Missing buy button!
notes.notes:
For some reason there's no buy button showing up on the page. Steam is contacted about this - so I hope that this will be sorted out shortly.

...Personally, I believe that Countess Conundrum has something to do with it...
